## Features

- 🎯 **AI Face Analysis** — Face detection, eye openness evaluation, and sharpness scoring
- ⭐ **Star Rating** — EXIF-compatible ratings (0–5), fully keyboard-driven
- 🖼️ **Single / Grid View** — Seamless switching for quick comparison workflows
- 📷 **RAW Support** — Canon, Nikon, Sony, Panasonic, Leica, Fujifilm
- ⌨️ **Keyboard-first** — Minimal mouse usage, reduce RSI risk
- 🔒 **100% Local** — No cloud uploads. Your photos stay on your machine

---

## Main Screen

### Header Bar

| Control | Description | Shortcut |
|---------|-------------|----------|
| Fit | Scale image to fit the viewport | `F` |
| 100% | Display at actual pixel size | `Z` |
| Single | Single image view | `S` |
| Grid | Multi-image comparison view | `G` |
| Undo / Redo | Revert or reapply the last action | `Ctrl+Z` / `Ctrl+Shift+Z` |
| Auto Advance | Automatically move to next image after rating | Toggle |
| Open Folder | Load a folder of images | `Ctrl+O` |
| Export | Export rated images | `Shift+E` |
| Settings | Open settings dialog | `Ctrl+,` |

### Library Panel (Left)

- Thumbnail list with drag & drop support
- Star rating filter (filter by 0–5 stars)
- Color label filter (Red / Yellow / Green / Blue)

### Inspector Panel (Right)

- EXIF metadata display
- RGB histogram
- Face close-up cards with AI metrics (Sharpness / Eyes / Smile)

## Keyboard Shortcuts

Press `?` or `F1` to show the shortcut overlay in-app.

### Single View

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `←` `→` `↑` `↓` | Navigate images |
| `Shift` + Arrow | Multi-select |
| `Ctrl+A` | Select all |
| `Esc` | Deselect |
| `1`–`5` | Set star rating |
| `0` | Clear rating |
| `6`–`9` | Set color label (Red / Yellow / Green / Blue) |
| `Space` | Toggle zoom |
| `F` | Fit to viewport |
| `Z` | 100% zoom |
| `+` / `-` | Zoom in / out |
| `G` | Switch to Grid View |
| `L` | Toggle Library panel |
| `R` | Toggle Inspector panel |
| `F11` | Fullscreen |

### Grid View

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `N` / `P` | Next / Previous image |
| `←` `→` `↑` `↓` | Pan (when zoomed) |
| `Esc` | Deselect |
| `D` | Remove selected from grid |
| `1`–`5` | Set star rating |
| `0` | Clear rating |
| `6`–`9` | Set color label |
| `Space` | Toggle zoom |
| `F` / `Z` | Fit / 100% |
| `+` / `-` | Zoom in / out |
| `S` | Switch to Single View |
| `L` / `R` | Toggle panels |
| `F11` | Fullscreen |

## System Requirements

| Item | Requirement |
|------|-------------|
| OS | Windows 10 / 11 (x64) |
| Runtime | .NET 9.0 Desktop Runtime (bundled with installer) |
| Disk | ~200 MB (app + models) |
| RAM | 8 GB minimum, 16 GB recommended |

---

## Installation

1. Go to the [Releases](https://github.com/saka-guchi/zen-cull/releases) page
2. Download `ZenCull-Setup.exe` from the latest release
3. Run the installer — no admin rights required
4. Launch Zen Cull from the Start Menu or Desktop shortcut

Updates are delivered automatically on app launch via Velopack.

---

## Getting Started

1. **Open a folder** — `Ctrl+O` or drag & drop a folder onto the window
2. **Browse photos** — Use arrow keys or click thumbnails
3. **Rate** — Press `1`–`5` to assign stars, `0` to clear
4. **Filter** — Click star filters in the Library panel to narrow down your selection
5. **Compare** — Press `G` to enter Grid View for side-by-side comparison
6. **Export** — Press `Shift+E` to export your rated selections
